description.value: A randomized 4-week NB32 versus placebo study assessed changes in fMRI brain reactivity to food cues before and after treatment in healthy women with obesity.

value: NB32 would decrease the reactivity of brain regions involved with reward while decreasing the deactivation of regions involved with regulatory control, relative to placebo.

description.value: Subjects had two imaging visits, one at baseline and one after 4 weeks of treatment; participants were randomly assigned to NB32 or placebo.
